descriptionChirho: Hebrew proper noun אֲבִיָּה / אֲבִיָּהוּ meaning 'Yah(u) is (my) father,' borne by several biblical figures including: (1) the son and successor of Rehoboam, king of Judah (2 Chr 11:20,22; 12:16; 13:1-22); (2) a son of Samuel who judged Israel (1 Sam 8:2); (3) a son of Jeroboam I (1 Kgs 14:1); (4) a priestly division head (1 Chr 24:10; Neh 12:17); and (5) various genealogical figures (1 Chr 2:24; 3:10; 6:28; 7:8). All auto-split clusters represent the same proper noun in different syntactic positions (with preposition ל, conjunction ו, or standalone). Arb أَبِيَّا, deu Abia, fra Abija, hin अबिय्याह / अबीयाह, kor 아비야, spa Abiya / Abias.
